title: 遠足とバスの場面
subject_en: Hand-drawn crayon scenes of a school excursion, each ONE small scene of two to four Japanese children with yellow caps or rucksacks, simple round faces with dot eyes and a smile, no school logos. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
lead: バスの座席・お弁当・リュック・集合写真など、遠足の場面12点です。おたよりや行事予定表に使えます。
items: children lining up to climb the steps of a tour bus with a teacher at the door
children sitting side by side on bus seats looking out of the window
children singing together on a bus, one teacher holding a microphone
children sitting in a neat group on grass while a teacher counts them
children sitting on a picnic sheet opening bento boxes
children holding small snack bags and smiling
children walking in a line holding hands along a path with a teacher at the end
children crouching to look at a snail and flowers with magnifying glasses
children and a teacher standing in two rows posing for a group photo
children drinking from water bottles under a tree
a child packing a rucksack with a lunch box, a water bottle and a hat
children sleeping on bus seats leaning on each other
